decisions.decision: The migration must NOT be applied to the real database (localhost:5432/magus) during tiers 2-3. The user runs `make migrate-up` themselves after tier 4.
decisions.why: User chose 'Not until tier 4 is done'. Applying tier 2 alone would leave the schema ahead of any still-running old poller binary, which would write miles into a column named odometer_km. Implementation and tests need only disposable testcontainers, so nothing is lost by waiting.

decisions.decision: Tasks 1.5, 1.6 and all of group 7 are leader-run, not worker-run; workers are forbidden from make migrate-up/migrate-down entirely.
decisions.why: Those targets read DATABASE_URL from .env, which points at the user's real database - and D3 puts it off limits. The leader performs the migrate round-trip on a disposable container instead. decisions.decision: Task 5.3's literal wording ('an unreported TPMS reading stays nil through snapshotFrom') is UNSATISFIABLE, and so is the matching clause of roadmap RD12. Accepted the worker's honest partial implementation rather than a false assertion.
decisions.why: tesla.VehicleStateTesla's four TPMS fields are plain float64, so encoding/json collapses 'key absent' and 'reported 0.0' into the same zero value and ptr() ALWAYS yields non-nil. Verified this predates RM7: the pre-change service.go did ptr(data.VehicleState.TpmsPressureFL) on the same plain float64. NULL therefore only ever means 'pre-migration row', never 'not reported'. RD12's claim that snapshotFrom creates the nil distinction is wrong as written. Not fixed here - it is a roadmap/spec wording defect, not a code defect, and belongs to whoever next touches that spec.

review.brief:
Review the DIFF of commits 195d6ec and f07c9ec on ft/RM7-store-display-units (`git diff 195d6ec~1..f07c9ec`). Do NOT read the whole module. Validate in priority order:
(1) DB-DESIGN FIDELITY - BLOCKER on any mismatch. The user confirmed design.md D1's SQL at a blocking gate (decision D1). internal/telemetry/db/migrations/20260806000001_store_display_units_vehicle_snapshots.sql must match that SQL block EXACTLY: all 15 RENAME COLUMN statements, ONE UPDATE rescaling ONLY the 6 value-changing columns (battery_range_km, odometer_km, tpms_pressure_{fl,fr,rl,rr}_psi) by 1.609344 / 14.503773773, and a Down that divides then renames back in reverse order. The 9 rename-only columns must NOT appear in the UPDATE's SET list. No column dropped, no row deleted, no type/nullability/constraint/index change anywhere. NOTE design.md D2's prose says 'exactly two indexed objects' but the live DB has three (vehicle_snapshots_pkey on (id) is omitted from the doc) - that is a KNOWN doc inaccuracy recorded as decision D2, NOT a design deviation, and the conclusion still holds because `id` is not renamed. Do not report it as a finding.
(2) Conversion lives ONLY in the adapter (RM7 RD6, design D3). grep the module: internal/telemetry must contain ZERO conversion factors and ZERO conversion methods in non-test Go. snapshotFrom must call data.ChargeState.BatteryRangeKm(), data.VehicleState.OdometerKm() and data.VehicleState.TpmsPressure{FL,FR,RL,RR}PSI(). An inline *1.609344 or *14.503773773 anywhere in non-test Go is a blocker.
(3) NULL-vs-zero fidelity (design D3). The TPMS conversion must be applied BEFORE ptr() wraps. A reported 0.0 bar stores non-NULL 0.0 PSI; a pre-migration NULL stays NULL. Temperature must be assigned straight from the DTO with NO conversion (the Fleet API already reports Celsius) - a stray conversion there is a blocker.
(4) Test honesty - the highest-value check in this review. Task 5.1 required restating values, not just renaming fields: a literal that meant 12000 MILES must not have silently become 12000 km. Walk the test diff and confirm each changed numeric literal either was restated into the display unit or converted (e.g. 210.5 mi -> 338.766912 km), and that any test asserting a relationship still holds arithmetically. Also confirm the two new snapshotFrom tests assert LITERAL expected values, not `input * 1.609344` - asserting against the factor under test pins nothing.
(5) A TEST FILE WAS DELETED: internal/telemetry/tpms_test.go. The leader already verified and accepted this (decision D5) on the grounds that it tested the domain-level Snapshot.TpmsPressure*PSI() companions on *float64 fields, both deleted by design D4, and that its coverage is re-homed in TestTPMS_NilRoundTrip plus the tesla adapter's tests and the new snapshotFrom test. VERIFY THAT INDEPENDENTLY - do not take the leader's word for it. If any behaviour the deleted file asserted is now untested, that is a finding.
(6) Known and accepted, do NOT re-report: task 5.3's wording ('an unreported TPMS reading stays nil through snapshotFrom') is unsatisfiable because tesla.VehicleStateTesla's TPMS fields are plain float64, so JSON collapses 'absent' and '0.0' and ptr() always yields non-nil. This predates RM7 and is recorded as decision D6. Confirm the worker implemented the provable half honestly rather than asserting something false; do not demand the impossible assertion.
(7) Module boundaries (ai/architecture.md): internal/telemetry imports only the account + tesla public ports; no tesla internals; pgtype confined to the store/mapping layer and absent from any public type; no HTML. internal/battery and internal/gateway must NOT have been edited - they are tiers 3 and 4.
(8) BUILD EXPECTATION - do not block on this. Per RM7 Decision 8 this tier DELIBERATELY leaves internal/battery and internal/gateway not compiling. The correct scope is `go build ./internal/telemetry/... ./internal/tesla/...`. A full-tree failure in exactly those two packages, on renamed fields / deleted companions, is the PLANNED outcome, not a defect. Any OTHER package failing, or a failure of a different kind, IS a defect.
(9) Docs: internal/telemetry/AGENTS.md now states the display-unit rule. Per task 6.2 this tier deliberately does NOT edit ai/go-conventions.md or the root CLAUDE.md - they belong to the separate platform-unit-of-measure-convention change, so those two files still stating the OLD read-time-companion rule is EXPECTED, not an incomplete tier.
(10) Anti-gaming: no task title, criterion or assertion weakened or deleted to look complete; tasks.md checkboxes match reality. Check every box independently - an earlier review in this repo asserted checkbox agreement without verifying and missed 10 unticked boxes.
ABSOLUTE PROHIBITION: .env's DATABASE_URL points at the user's REAL database and this migration renames 15 columns and rewrites every row. NEVER run make migrate-up/migrate-down/db-setup/db-reset, psql, or anything connecting to DATABASE_URL. Run tests only as `env -u DATABASE_URL go test ./internal/telemetry/...` (testcontainers). Never call the live Tesla API. Verification already done by the leader: module build/vet/test green; migration round-trip proven on a disposable container (12000mi->19312.128km, 2.9bar->42.060944psi, NULL preserved, down restores within float tolerance); openspec validate --strict valid. Escalate on doubt: return changes-requested rather than approving anything you are unsure of.
